subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which redacted session identity and token or transcript-size fields should the shared user-visible context-overflow contract expose across private and shared channels?
rationale: The implementation must balance actionable diagnostics against disclosure of session and channel identifiers, while also defining which token sources are authoritative enough to present as exact values.

options.title: Redacted Shared Diagnostics
options.body: Expose a safe display label, provider/model, effective budget, best available token observation with estimate semantics, overage, and channel-appropriate recovery actions through one formatter.

options.title: Minimal Model Diagnostics
options.body: Expose only provider/model, effective budget, and recovery actions while retaining session identity and detailed measurements in structured logs and status output.

options.title: Logs Only
options.body: Keep generic user-facing copy and improve only structured logs, status, and diagnostic commands.

recommendation.title: Redacted Shared Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose a safe display label, provider/model, effective budget, best available token observation with estimate semantics, overage, and channel-appropriate recovery actions through one formatter.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history trail spans the runner, compaction, and auto-reply decision surfaces where this contract must be coordinated.
